name: ui.flare
description: One soft edged radial starburst flare made of chunky pale cream and golden pixel clusters, strongest white core, transparent fade outward, four long rays and four tiny rays.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE original dark fantasy pixel art UI asset. Thick near-black outlines, bold pixel clusters, high contrast, minimal shading, muted metal and stone. No letters, no words, no numbers, no labels, no watermark, no commercial game imitation. One soft edged radial starburst flare made of chunky pale cream and golden pixel clusters, strongest white core, transparent fade outward, four long rays and four tiny rays. Centered with 5 percent transparent outer padding. Genuine transparent background.
